renewal: Maintain the applicable approval and verify current renewal/continuing conditions.

title: Distinguish NYC employment placement from actual staffing

affectedParty: Proposed local operating entity and responsible management

renewal: Maintain the applicable approval and verify current renewal/continuing conditions.
